title: Computational compressive imaging reconstruction with a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种基于模拟退火伊辛求解器的计算压缩成像重建方法，成功应用于单像素成像和无透镜成像。 Computational compressive imaging, such as single-pixel imaging and lensless imaging, is a promising imaging technique, enabling the reconstruction of objects from under-sampled measurements through compressed sensing algorithms or deep learning methods. However, the demand for electronic computational resources grows rapidly when recovering high-resolution and multi-dimensional images and training neural networks with numerous parameters, which has become a bottleneck for the widespread adoption of this technique. Here, we propose a physics-driven reconstruction framework that formulates imaging inverse problems as Ising models and directly recovers target objects through the self-evolution of non-von Neumann Ising machines toward the ground state of the Hamiltonian. We employ a simulated-annealing-based Ising solver to demonstrate this proof-of-concept by reconstructing objects in both single-pixel imaging and a lensless diffuser camera at sampling rates ranging from 1% to 25%. By further incorporating a foreground-sparsity constraint and a smoothness constraint, the reconstruction quality of our method is comparable to or even better than that of mainstream algorithms. This approach has the potential to substantially reduce the electronic computational burden of inverse reconstruction, paving the way for real-time, low-power computational imaging.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种基于模拟退火伊辛求解器的计算压缩成像重建方法，并成功应用于单像素成像和无透镜成像。计算压缩成像（如单像素成像和无透镜成像）是一种前景广阔的成像技术，它能够通过压缩感知算法或深度学习方法，从欠采样测量数据中重建物体。 然而，在恢复高分辨率和多维图像以及训练包含大量参数的神经网络时，对电子计算资源的需求迅速增长，这已成为该技术广泛应用的主要瓶颈。 在此，我们提出了一种基于物理的框架，该框架将成像反问题表述为伊辛模型，并通过非冯·诺依曼伊辛机向哈密顿量基态的自演化过程直接恢复目标物体。 我们采用一种基于模拟退火的伊辛求解器来验证这一概念，通过在单像素成像和无透镜漫射相机中以1%至25%的采样率重建物体，展示了该方法的有效性。 通过进一步引入前景稀疏性约束和平滑性约束，我们的方法在重建质量上可与主流算法相媲美，甚至更优。 这种方法有望显著降低反问题重建的电子计算负担，为实时、低功耗的计算成像铺平道路。
